description_en: Retrieve the list of trace assessment results. This API is used together with the EvaluateTrace API. The EvaluateTrace API triggers the assessment operation, and ListEvalResults retrieves the assessment results
description_zh: 获取链路数据评估结果列表。和EvaluateTrace API搭配使用。EvaluateTrace触发评估操作。ListEvalResults获取评估结果
name: ListEvalResults

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.
Pages start from page 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。 起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值10，最大值50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the evaluation task. Will return the latest evaluation result if this ID not provied
parameters.help_zh: 链路数据所属的评估任务的任务id
parameters.name: evaluation_id

parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，在评估输入数据里查询
parameters.name: keyword

Code.description_en: Internal error code. Set only when the response has an error
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

items.description_en: Evaluation result of a single trace record
items.description_zh: 一条链路记录的评估结果

Message.description_en: Response error message. Set only when the response has an error
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的评估结果的总数
